note: Germany takes Anschluss in 1937 and then subjugates Czechoslovakia.
World War II starts on 1 January 1939 and Europe collapses in a month.
The Axis pushes through Egypt and all the way down toward South Africa, but is later pushed back up to the Ethiopia line. West Africa holds until late 1939 and then is pushed by the Axis.
Winter War: Finland holds briefly, then loses and returns to the normal border.
Japan declares in early 1941, invades the Dutch East Indies and the Philippines, and pushes up to the river line in India.
Barbarossa begins on 28 March 1941; by June the key Soviet cities are taken.
